[ndma_heatwave_01] அதிகாரப்பூர்வ வழிகாட்டுதல்களின்படி:
## Do's During Extreme Heat (Source: IMD-NDMA Guidelines, Page 1)
- Listen to Radio, watch TV, read newspaper for local weather news or download weather information mobile apps.
- Drink sufficient water and stay hydrated even if not thirsty. Persons on fluid-restricted diets should consult a doctor before increasing intake.
- Use ORS (Oral Rehydration Solution), homemade drinks like lassi, torani (rice water), lemon water, buttermilk, and coconut water to keep yourself hydrated.
- Wear lightweight, light-coloured, loose, and porous cotton clothes.
- If outside, cover your head: use a cloth, hat, or umbrella. Use sunglasses to protect eyes and sunscreen to protect skin.
- Provide resting shade, clean drinking water, buttermilk, first-aid kits with ice-packs and ORS for all workers at workplaces.
- Schedule strenuous jobs to cooler times of the day; increase frequency and length of rest breaks for outdoor activities.
- In case of heat stroke emergencies, call National Emergency helpline 112 or Disaster helpline 1077.

[ndma_coldwave_03] அதிகாரப்பூர்வ வழிகாட்டுதல்களின்படி:
## Vulnerable Groups and Winter Shelter (Source: IMD-NDMA Guidelines, Page 1 & 3)
- Special protection for vulnerable populations: newborn infants, elderly individuals, chronically ill persons, and homeless citizens.
- Maintain comfortable indoor room temperature and protect children and elderly from drafts.
- District administrations provide night shelters (Rain Baseras) equipped with blankets and hot water for homeless persons during severe cold wave.
- Emergency assistance and shelter helplines: call National Emergency helpline 112 or Disaster helpline 1077.
- Domestic cattle and pets protection: keep animals inside sheds at night, provide dry bedding, protect from cold winds, and increase protein/mineral rations.

[flood_cyclone_safety_02] அதிகாரப்பூர்வ வழிகாட்டுதல்களின்படி:
## Cyclone and Lightning Safety Measures (Source: IMD-NDMA Guidelines, Page 1-3)
- Cyclone precautions: inspect and secure loose roof tiles or tin sheets; board or tape glass windows.
- Keep emergency kits ready: non-perishable food, potable drinking water, torches, battery radio, and first-aid supplies.
- Unhook and disconnect electrical appliances during cyclones to prevent short-circuits and electrical fires.
- Lightning safety 30/30 rule: if the time between lightning flash and thunder is less than 30 seconds, take shelter indoors; wait 30 minutes after last thunder before heading outdoors.
- If outdoor during lightning: avoid tall isolated trees, open fields, elevated ridges, and metal structures; if hair stands on neck, squat low with hands on knees.

[icar_agriculture_advisory_02] அதிகாரப்பூர்வ வழிகாட்டுதல்களின்படி:
## Cold Wave, Frost and Ground Freeze Crop Protection (Source: IMD Agrimet Agriculture Guidance, Page 2-3)
- Apply light and frequent irrigation or sprinkler irrigation in evening hours to protect crops from cold injury and ground frost.
- In rice nursery beds: cover nursery beds with polythene sheets during the night and remove in the morning; irrigate in the evening and drain out in the morning.
- Cover young orchard fruit plants with straw, sarkanda, gunny bags, or polythene sheets.
- To protect sensitive crops like mustard, gram, and rajmah from frost injury, spray dilute sulphuric acid @ 0.1% (1 L in 1000 L water) or thiourea @ 500 ppm.
- Animal husbandry in winter: keep cattle and goats inside sheds during night, provide dry bedding, and supplement daily feed with mineral mixtures, salt, and jaggery.
